steps: Sign up as a YEP Energy customer on a fixed-rate plan of one year or longer.
Use the Refer A Friend form at yepenergy.com to invite friends by email, or share your YEP Energy account number.
Friend enrolls as a new YEP Energy customer on a fixed-term plan of one year or longer and enters your YEP Energy account number at order time.
Both you and the friend pay three full billing cycles on time.
After three paid cycles, $25 bill credit posts to each account.
